lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 003: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: The out-of-band prd.json amendment recommended by the prior three blocked dispatches (drop the literal 'named-command ' prefix from the 6 acceptanceCriteria oracle strings under US-001 AC3/AC4, US-002 AC2/AC5, US-003 AC5/AC7) has already been applied on this branch in commit a5ce063c, authored outside a CAM_WORKER=1 implementer session (as required, since .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh unconditionally denies Write/Edit/MultiEdit against scripts/cam/prd.json for every CAM_WORKER=1 session). This dispatch verified the resolution rather than re-doing it: `grep -n "oracle: named-command" scripts/cam/prd.json` now returns zero matches (was 8), and all 6 previously-127 oracle directives were re-run verbatim this session with exit 0 each (2 file-content greps, 1 negative-grep-plus-bun-test pair via test/init.test.ts, 1 negative-grep, 1 bun test of test/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts, 1 negative-grep, 1 conjunctive grep-pair on README.md). No source/template/binary file needed a change for this story: the reviewer finding's entire mechanical fix was the prd.json oracle-text edit itself, and that edit already exists on this branch. Working tree was clean at start and stayed clean; no commit was created by this dispatch since there is no diff left to commit beyond what a5ce063c already carries.

The story's own notes flag a second, distinct product/doc mismatch explicitly marked out of scope for this PR: templates/commands/cam-issue.md:132 and the implementer/reviewer agent contracts still display the '[oracle: named-command ...]' prefixed form as the documented spec, while templates/agents/subagent-planner.md:158 and classifyOracleText (src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts:108-125) expect the bare command -- so a planner following the documented form will keep emitting unrunnable directives in future PRDs. Needs its own filed issue (not filed by this dispatch, per the story notes' explicit scope boundary).
nextStoryContext: US-R2-003's reviewer finding (6 dead 'named-command'-prefixed oracle directives in scripts/cam/prd.json) is now resolved and verified: zero remaining 'oracle: named-command' occurrences, and all 6 affected directives (US-001 AC3/AC4, US-002 AC2/AC5, US-003 AC5/AC7) independently exit 0 when re-run verbatim from prd.json. Full quality spine re-verified green this session: `bun run typecheck` 0 errors, `bun test` 5760 pass / 0 fail across 344 files, and `bun run check:all` all 14 gates ok (typecheck, test, embed-vendor, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps, skip-ratchet). No code changes were needed or made by this dispatch. This closes out the review-round-2 fix batch (US-R2-001, US-R2-002, US-R2-003) for this PRD; the still-open product/doc mismatch (templates/commands/cam-issue.md vs subagent-planner.md/classifyOracleText disagreeing on whether the oracle directive carries a 'named-command ' prefix) is intentionally out of scope here and needs a separately filed follow-up issue so future PRDs don't regenerate the same class of dead oracle.
